triples.tail_surface: Leave the assembly of a mechanical seal with PTFE (Teflon) covered O-rings to a specialist
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 将PTFE包覆O型圈机械密封的装配交由专业人员
triples.evidence_text: Leave the assembly of a mechanical seal with PTFE (Teflon) covered O-rings to a specialist.

triples.tail_surface: Leave the seal in its original packing until you are ready to fit it
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在安装前将密封件保留在原包装中
triples.evidence_text: Leave the seal in its original packing until you are ready to fit it!

triples.tail_canonical_zh: 彻底清洁所有接收部件

triples.tail_surface: Never touch the sliding surfaces with ones fingers
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 严禁用手指触摸滑动面
triples.evidence_text: Never touch the sliding surfaces with ones fingers!

triples.tail_surface: Never put the rings down on their sliding surfaces
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 严禁将密封环滑动面朝下放置
triples.evidence_text: Never put the rings down on their sliding surfaces!

triples.head_surface: rotating part of the mechanical seal
triples.tail_surface: Remove the rotating part of the mechanical seal (1220) from the pump shaft
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 从泵轴上拆卸机械密封旋转部件
triples.evidence_text: Remove the rotating part of the mechanical seal (1220) from the pump shaft.

triples.head_surface: counter ring of the mechanical seal
triples.tail_surface: push the counter ring of the mechanical seal out of the intermediate cover
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 将机械密封静环从中间盖中推出
triples.evidence_text: push the counter ring of the mechanical seal out of the intermediate cover.

triples.tail_surface: Put some grease on the oil catcher (1235) and fit it into the intermediate cover (0110)
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在挡油环上涂抹润滑脂并装入中间盖
triples.evidence_text: Put some grease on the oil catcher (1235) and fit it into the intermediate cover (0110).

triples.head_surface: counter ring of the mechanical seal
triples.tail_surface: Wet the seal chamber of the intermediate cover with some low-surface-tension water (add detergent) and fit the counter ring of the mechanical seal straight into it
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 用低表面张力水润湿中间盖密封腔并将静环垂直装入
triples.evidence_text: Wet the seal chamber of the intermediate cover with some low-surface-tension water (add detergent) and fit the counter ring of the mechanical seal straight into it.

triples.tail_surface: Feed the rotating part of the seal with a slight twist in clockwise direction onto the shaft until the rear end of the bellows is at equal level with the shaft shoulder
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 顺时针微旋将密封旋转部件推入轴上直至波纹管后端与轴肩齐平
triples.evidence_text: Feed the rotating part of the seal with a slight twist in clockwise direction onto the shaft until the rear end of the bellows is at equal level with the shaft shoulder.

triples.tail_surface: Apply pressure or tension during assembly via the rear end of the bellows only
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 装配时仅通过波纹管后端施加压力或拉力
triples.evidence_text: Apply pressure or tension during assembly via the rear end of the bellows only.

triples.tail_surface: Wet the pump shaft with some low-surface-tension water (add detergent). Do not use oil or grease!
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 用低表面张力水润湿泵轴，禁止使用油或润滑脂
triples.evidence_text: Wet the pump shaft with some low-surface-tension water (add detergent). Do not use oil or grease!
